doc_title_en: Notice of Revision to Operating Performance Forecast and Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase) for FY2027/3
doc_title_jp: 業績予想の修正及び配当予想の修正（増配）に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 業績上方修正（通期親会社株主帰属純利益560億円、前回330億円比69.7%増）に基づき配当性向30%以上の方針を適用

summary_en: Annual dividend raised to 110 yen/share from 80 yen for FY3/27, driven by uplifted full-year profit guidance to 560 billion yen (69.7% above prior forecast). Payout ratio maintained at 30%+ policy floor. Q2 interim dividend held at 40 yen; year-end dividend increased to 70 yen from 40 yen.
summary_jp: FY3/27通期配当を80円から110円に修正。通期利益予想560億円に上方修正（前回比69.7%増）を踏まえ。配当性向30%以上の方針維持。中間配当40円据置、期末配当を40円から70円に増配。
tag_en: Dividend hike - 110 yen/share (from 80 yen) - FY3/27 - payout ratio 30%+
tag_jp: 配当予想修正 - 110円/株（前回80円） - FY2027年3月期 - 配当性向30%以上
